# Linux-derived components

This directory is reserved for selected open-source Linux hardware support that may be adapted behind CustomOS driver interfaces.

Planned areas:
- USB host controllers and HID
- Intel AX201 / iwlwifi-derived wireless support
- storage
- Ethernet/network hardware

The Linux kernel itself is NOT the CustomOS kernel.

When code is actually imported/adapted:
1. keep the original copyright header;
2. keep the upstream license text;
3. record the exact source/version;
4. document the CustomOS adaptation boundary.
